messages:
kai: kicking off the v2 gradual cutoff now — starting with 5% traffic to v2 route. watching latencies and 5xxs. pinging ops-oncall and sam for client-impact notes
sam: noted. have we normalized the client header casing? last time some mobile SDKs had case-sensitive matching.
marie: mobile SDKs were updated in canary last week but not all tenants. we should add a small shim: header casefolding at the gateway for 24h.
kai: agree. can we hotpatch the gateway config? deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: v2-route-cutover-phase1 -> apply config change to gateway-prod-1 in 2m. CI checks passed.
sam: if we casefold, we need to mention it in the release notes and the compatibility doc. add a short note: "gateway will tolerate Header-Case differences for 24h".
marie: ops-oncall FYI: fallback trigger = sustained 2% error rate increase for 5m or p90 latency +100ms for 5m; rollback window = immediate; runbook linked: https://infracorp/runbooks/v2-cutover
ops-oncall: got it. I'll watch metrics and run the rollback if threshold hits. set me an alert for 1.5% error bump too.
kai: timeline: t+0 -> 5%; t+10m -> 20% if green; t+30m -> 50%; t+60m -> 100% unless blocked. anyone object?
sam: quick question — for tenants pinned to v1 via header signal, do we auto-keep them pinned? I remember a small cohort had pin persistence issues.
marie: yes, pin persistence remains; we preserved header pin cookie. but note there was a bug in the edge shim that dropped pins when route fallback happened. fixed in patch 2026.03.12.
kai: excellent. release notes snippet ready? sam: short blurb: "API v2 rollout: header normalization guard, pin persistence maintained, rollback thresholds set; minor behavior change for streaming chunk boundaries (backwards compatible)"
deploy-bot: rollout step completed: 5% traffic shifted to v2 (gateway-prod-1). Observability checks: errors 0.05% -> baseline.
marie: looks clean on mobile telemetry. users on sdk<1.4 still small, we will notify owners of those tenants via #customer-success.
ops-oncall: seeing a minor spike in p95 on eu-region - investigating. adding detail: it correlates with auth token TTL refresh earlier.
sam: if p95 persists past 7m at +80ms, we pause. kai: agreed. pausing plan in place: operator pause command -> `/deploy pause v2-route-cutover`
ops-oncall: spike subsided after TTL sledder completed. metrics back to baseline. proceeding to 20% at t+12m.
deploy-bot: rollout step completed: 20% traffic shifted to v2. No errors above threshold.
kai: good. final checklist: 1) docs note + release note updated, 2) customer-success pinged tenants with older SDKs, 3) autoscaling headroom checked for v2 nodes, 4) operator oncall on watch. anything else?
sam: add a quick eval for generation diffs for top-20 tenants (sanity set) — if quality regress > 2% for any, we'll rollback.
marie: I'll start the eval job now and post results in 10m.
deploy-bot: final step scheduled: t+60m -> 100% unless paused.
kai: thanks all. keep this thread for rollforward/rollback decision notes. :thumbsup:
